title: madengine performance result row
description: Shape of one row of perf.csv. Property order is column order. Columns that restate a manifest field carry x-manifest-source, a JSON pointer into build_manifest.schema.json, so the two shapes cannot be renamed apart without a test failing.

model.description: Model name as it appears in the manifest.

n_gpus.description: GPUs the model asked for; -1 means all visible GPUs.

training_precision.description: Precision the model was run at, e.g. bf16, fp8.

pipeline.description: Pipeline the model belongs to, from its model card.

args.description: Arguments passed to the run script.

tags.description: Model card tags, flattened to a comma-separated string.

docker_file.description: Dockerfile the image was built from.

base_docker.description: Base image the Dockerfile started from.

docker_sha.description: Image digest, as reported by the container runtime at run time.

git_commit.description: Commit of the model repository the run script came from.

machine_name.description: Host the run reported from; the head node for a multi-node run.

gpu_architecture.description: GPU architecture detected at run time, e.g. gfx950.

performance.description: The metric value. Empty when the workload produced no metric.

metric.description: Unit of the performance value, e.g. tokens/s/GPU.

relative_change.description: Change against the recorded baseline, when one exists.

status.description: Outcome of the run. SUCCESS only when the workload succeeded and a metric was collected.

data_provider_type.description: How the dataset was made available, e.g. nas, minio, custom.

data_size.description: Dataset size as reported by the provider.

build_number.description: CI build number, when the run came from CI.

additional_docker_run_options.description: Extra options passed to docker run.
